question: Among members who attended any 'Guest Speaker' type event and have a t-shirt size of 'Large', what percentage incurred an expense related to 'Posters'?

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.XCL_018 = 'Posters' THEN m.XCL_034 END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_034) 
FROM member m
INNER JOIN attendance a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN event ev ON a.XCL_001 = ev.XCL_010
INNER JOIN budget b ON ev.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
INNER JOIN expense e ON b.XCL_003 = e.XCL_023
WHERE ev.XCL_013 = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND m.XCL_039 = 'Large'
